points.point: Automotive is explicitly named as an industry showing interest in 5G NTN-NR, on the same slide that credits SMW200A channel emulation (long path delays, Doppler, customized dynamic fading) for NTN testing — the clearest SigGen link to automotive demand.
points.label: contradicted
points.why: identifies eCall/SMBV100B as strongest instead of NTN and omits NTN evidence

points.point: The Vault already defines a reusable signal generator + signal analyzer component-test pairing (SMW200A + FSW) for NTN, which is the configuration an automotive NTN module/chipset opportunity would use.
points.label: missing
points.why: no SMW200A + FSW NTN component-test pairing

points.point: The analyzer side of that pair is specified to 85 GHz (overrange 90 GHz) with up to 8 GHz analysis bandwidth, i.e. sufficient reach for mmWave/automotive-radar-band analysis work.
points.label: partial
points.why: mentions FSW 85/90 GHz and 8 GHz bandwidth, but not as NTN pair analyzer

points.point: Radar echo generation is an orderable SMW200A software option (SMW-K78), making radar echo generation an attach opportunity for the signal generator line itself.
points.label: missing
points.why: no SMW200A SMW-K78 radar echo option

points.point: The AREG800A offers automotive radar production configurations (AREG-P1/P2/P3 with digital channels, 5 GHz instantaneous bandwidth, MFP/BFP frontends), indicating an automotive radar production-test opportunity.
points.label: partial
points.why: mentions AREG800A radar echo opportunity, not AREG-P1/P2/P3 production configs or 5 GHz/digital channel details

points.point: Critical scoping caveat: the Vault explicitly classifies the AREG800A automotive radar echo generator as outside the RF signal generator / spectrum analyzer category, so it must not be counted as a SigGen/SA opportunity.
points.label: covered
points.why: states AREG800A is not RF signal generator or spectrum analyzer

points.point: R&S's documented automotive demand driver is NG eCall regulation (obligatory from 2026-01-01), but the instrument of record there is the CMX500 mobile radio tester, not a signal generator or analyzer.
points.label: covered
points.why: states NG eCall 2026 obligation and CMX500 is radio tester, not SG/SA

points.point: 6G NTN is a forward-looking automotive pipeline item: the Vault lists automotive V2X safety applications among 6G NTN use cases, a future driver for channel-emulation-capable generators and analyzers.
points.label: missing
points.why: no 6G NTN automotive V2X pipeline item
